public class FormatBeside
  extends CompoundFormat
This is a compound Format class for a list of Formats that should be printed 'beside' each other. This means, that each text is printed beside the end of the last line of the text before it. This is only done, if all component formats would fit into the given maximal width. If not, the default behaviour (to print the components beneath each other) is assumed.
